summary: Bochner / Weitzenböck layer: `BochnerCertificate` with the 1-form Laplacian, rough Laplacian and Ricci contraction as explicit fields; a kernel-checked Euclidean instance (Ric = 0) whose identity is exactly the discrete Laplacian commutation; a kernel-checked gradient-estimate toy `Δ(|∇f|²) ≥ 2|Hess f|²` under the `Ricci ≥ 0` certificate field; and a state-only smooth Bochner formula Prop with named blockers and exact missing dependencies.

scaffold.requested_command_note: hard links rejected on this filesystem (`Invalid cross-device link`) for every entry, matching the D7-divergence card

toolchain.root_package: D7RiemannCurvatureTensorRoot (re-exposes release/.lake so `lake env lean` works from the worktree root)

mathlib_probe.absent_probe_mechanism: #check_failure (all 12 fail to resolve at the pinned revision)
api_notes: The pinned mathlib has `CovariantDerivative` and a constructed `leviCivitaConnection`, so the connection itself is not a blocker.
There is no Hessian (second covariant derivative), no Laplace-Beltrami operator, no rough Laplacian on forms, and no manifold-level Riemann/Ricci curvature at the pinned revision.
`Mathlib.Geometry.Manifold` contains no curvature file; the D7 curvature/Ricci layers are finite-dimensional algebraic models.
The finite-dimensional model uses `ZMod N` configuration spaces; `ZMod` arithmetic is kept out of the numeric examples, which use explicit matrices instead.

new_files.role: finite-dimensional pointwise model, scalar Bochner quantities, `BochnerCertificate`
finite cyclic difference model, Laplacian commutation, Euclidean (Ric = 0) certificate
`GradientCertificate`, unconditional Bochner inequality and the gradient estimate
concrete flat/curved certificates, estimate instances, negative control
state-only smooth Bochner formula, Weitzenböck and gradient-estimate Props, blockers, missing dependencies

scalar_quantities.ricciPairing: ∑ i, ∑ j, grad i * ric i j * grad j = Ric(∇f, ∇f)

euclidean_instance.model: functions on the finite cyclic configuration space `Conf (Fin n) N = Fin n → ZMod N`; `shift i f x = f (x + Pi.single i 1)`, `diff i f x = shift i f x - f x`, `laplacian f = ∑ i, diff i (diff i f)`
euclidean_instance.commutation_theorem: diff_laplacian_comm: diff j (laplacian f) = laplacian (diff j f)
euclidean_instance.identity_reduction: Euclidean.oneFormLaplacian_eq_roughLaplacian_of_commutation: if ∀ i, laplacian (diff i f) x = diff i (laplacian f) x then oneFormLaplacian f x = roughLaplacian f x
euclidean_instance.certificate: Euclidean.euclideanBochnerCertificate f x, with ric = 0 and ricciContraction = 0

gradient_estimate.model: GradientCertificate extends a BochnerCertificate with gradLap = ∇Δf, laplacianGradNormSq = Δ(|∇f|²), rough_decomposition (roughLaplacian = |Hess f|² + ⟨∇f, ∇Δf⟩), product_rule (Δ(|∇f|²) = 2 ⟨Δ₁ df, df⟩) and harmonic (⟨∇f, ∇Δf⟩ = 0)

theorems.gradient_estimate: 2 * hessNormSq C.B.hess ≤ C.laplacianGradNormSq (uses the harmonicity field)

non_vacuity.curved_example: grad = (1,2), hess = [[3,1],[1,4]], ric = [[2,0],[0,3]]: |Hess|² = 27, Ric(∇f,∇f) = 14, roughLaplacian = 27, oneFormLaplacian = 41, Δ(|∇f|²) = 82; estimate 54 ≤ 82 (strict)
non_vacuity.negative_control: RawGradientModel without the Ricci-sign field: hessNormSq = 27, ricciContraction = -100, laplacianGradNormSq = -146; negativeControl_estimate_fails proves ¬ (2*27 ≤ -146), so the Ricci ≥ 0 field is essential

statements.SmoothBochnerFormulaStatement: Δ(|∇f|²) = 2|∇²f|² + 2⟨∇f, ∇Δf⟩ + 2Ric(∇f, ∇f) for every smooth f and point x of a Riemannian manifold

blocked.consistency: SmoothBochnerDatum.isSmooth_zero_of_isEmpty: the zero datum satisfies the predicate on an empty manifold; SmoothBochnerDatum.zero_not_isSmooth_of_nontrivial records that it fails on a nontrivial manifold
